title: Vanilla+ Waiter Edition
description: A little vanilla-ish Mod for Forge
body: ![Vanilla+ Waiter Edition](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a7b6ff9055bdc9a58b70022de2f43a1b74100631.png) ![Environment](https://img.shields.io/badge/environment-server%26client-blue?style=flat-square) A little vanilla-ish Mod for Forge ## 📖 What is this Mod This is a WIP Mod with random Stuff that I code. Feel free to suggest new features! I'll try to add them in my free time. ## ✅ Features ### TNT Launcher You can load it with TNT from your off-hand and shoot it! ![TNT Launcher Shooting](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/310f6387-0344-455b-a8f9-8fa938527fdf) ### Blowgun Just a bow for now (WIP). Later, it will shoot other Projectiles. ![Blowgun Shooting](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/84507f7a-6c51-45ef-92a4-03d106345cc1) ### Propeller Stick A stick that can launch you in the direction you are looking. ![Propeller Sitck Launching](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/1c36c85f-6764-4970-a8c9-9ffe6768da98) ### Zombie Heart You can eat it to feel sick or you can give it to other entities to make them explode! ![Zombie Heart Explosion](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/804d50d5-12f8-411f-9c21-bd6b094f7e8b) ## 📖 Usage Just install it in your mods folder. It has no Dependecies right now. ### Feel free to use this Mod in your Modpack!
